recl1wvjyRP3XfBBu.Bio: Marty Leeds is a gematria researcher, author and preacher who founded The Gnostic Church and Academy of Lord Jesus Christ in 2022, where he serves as head teacher and spiritual leader. A working minister since 2011, he is the author of more than ten books, among them the Pi & The English Alphabet series, Scripture in the Stars, The Keys to the Tarot and Gnosticism Defined: The Tenets of The Order, built around a mathematical cipher he says is hidden beneath the English alphabet. His teaching centers on Prisca Theologia, the idea of a single wisdom underlying the world's religions, drawing together gematria, Kabbalah, astrology and comparative mythology. He streams weekly sermons free through the Gnostic Academy's YouTube and Rumble channels.
recl1wvjyRP3XfBBu.Name: Marty Leeds

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The sky itself is the scripture", "body": "Chance Garton opens by flipping the usual claim about astrotheology. He is not saying biblical stories were later drawn into the constellations. He is saying the heavens are the original text, and every wisdom tradition on earth is an interpretation of that one story running above our heads. Marty Leeds agrees, describing the whole canopy of stars as the celestial template, the sky father, the pattern. Reading Genesis one, verse fourteen through sixteen, Leeds argues the verse is telling us plainly that those things are lights placed for signs and for keeping time, and that light in a religious sense means divine truth."}, {"title": "A church built on the mystery school tradition", "body": "Leeds explains what he has been doing since his last visit. He started a church, the Gnostic Academy of Lord Jesus Christ, holding Sunday service at nine every week. The focus is the Prisca Theologia, comparative mythology, the alchemical and hermetic corpuses, gematria and number symbolism, but mainly the Bible. Both men argue the organized faiths corporatized religion, selling only the exoteric layer to the masses while keeping the esoteric meat and the sciences behind it out of view. Leeds is careful to say history is hard to suss out, but concludes that if churches were meant to be custodians of the mysteries, they have failed."}, {"title": "John the Baptist as a star map", "body": "The clearest worked example comes from Mark one, verse six. Why does the Bible bother telling us what John eats? Leeds reads the verse straight off the sky around the pole star. The camel's hair is Camelopardalis, the girdle of skin about his loins is Orion's belt, the locusts are the constellation Lacerta, and the wild honey is the Beehive cluster in Cancer. Chance adds that the wilderness in scripture is the sky itself, a place where nobody lives and nobody goes. Leeds calls it an ingenious encoding of the living stars into a single verse."}, {"title": "The crucifixion laid out in constellations", "body": "Chance brings up Joseph of Arimathea and the sepulcher from Matthew. Leeds points to the Southern Cross, then to Norma, Circinus and Triangulum sitting beside it, the surveyor's level, compasses and square, the carpenter's tools carried by a man named Joseph, which means he will add, from Arimathea, which sounds like arithmetic. Centaurus stands over the scene as the centurion. Scorpio serves as Saint John, the one disciple present. Ophiuchus supplies the coffin, and the keystone of Hercules is the rolled stone. Hercules running through the sky is Jesus rolling away his own tomb."}, {"title": "Puns, phonology and the revelation of the logos", "body": "Chance brings in John McHugh's cuneiform work and the book The Celestial Code of Scripture, showing how the star Regulus, called Sharru in Sumerian and Akkadian, encodes child, king, father and he increases all at once, which lands on the name Joseph. Leeds defends phonology as a legitimate key, offering son and sun, Vishnu becoming fish and bishop, Dagon and dragon. The two agree the ancient astronomer priests treated these wordplays as the logos revealing itself. Leeds tempers it with a warning about internet gematria, saying God speaks constantly but people often mishear and dictate the signal badly."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Marty Leeds has manifested a mathmagical ministry over the last year with his work at the Gnostic Academy of Lord Jesus Christ, with anagogical analysis that enlivens the Bible by demonstrating the stellar origins of the myths it retells. Tonight we'll be exploring details from his new book, Scripture in the Stars, and learning more about the astrotheology encoded in the Christian mysteries.
